jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job As part of a growing and dynamic Commercial Portfolio Management team, the Bilingual Senior Commercial Account Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management of an assigned group of lending partners and associated portfolio of mortgages, from funding through maturity. Additional credit-related and administrative duties are also required such as reporting and pipeline management as well as networking with external business partners along with various staff within the Commercial department & other internal departments.

jobs.description_text: The Work As part of a growing, dynamic & solution-focused commercial team, the Commercial Mortgage Underwriter is responsible for underwriting conventional commercial mortgages. Additional credit-related and administrative duties are also required such as reporting and pipeline management. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Growth (12 month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work The Data Scientist, Growth leads the design, development, deployment, and operationalization of advanced analytics and machine learning solutions that support growth, customer experience, and commercial decision-making. The role translates ambiguous business problems into measurable data science solutions, with a focus on pricing, customer engagement, recommendation systems, experimentation, and model-driven decision support. The role works across the full analytical lifecycle, from problem framing and exploratory analysis through model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and production implementation. It also contributes to the modernization, migration, and scaling of machine learning assets and data workflows across cloud platforms and enterprise analytical environments.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Operations and Servicing
jobs.description_text: EQ Bank is changing how Canadians experience banking, and how we serve and protect our customers is central to that mission. As Director, Product Management – Operations & Servicing, you will set the product vision for two critical areas: Care & Servicing (customer care tooling, agentic AI servicing, CRM, and front- and back-office operations) and Risk (fraud and AML systems and controls). You will lead a team of product leaders, owning domain strategy, prioritization, and executive representation while coaching your Leads to deliver measurable outcomes. You will also be the product leader for two of the most significant workstreams in the EQ × PCF integration, customer servicing and fraud/AML. Your work will directly shape how customers are served and protected as the business grows.

jobs.title: Fraud Analyst - Cards
jobs.description_text: The Fraud Analyst – Cards, will conduct investigative analysis to identify, assess, decision and report on activity that indicates an exposure to financial crimes. The incumbent will manage inbound calls and assist clients to ensure potential threats and investigations are evaluated, documented, managed and escalated by following standard operating procedures. They will provide subject matter expertise and oversight of criminal risk by following a disciplined and intelligence-based approach to detection and research of activities and events in alignment with EQ Bank’s fraud program and standards to ensure compliance as well as support trending, analysis and insights generation.

jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 The Strategic Sourcing & Third-Party Management (SS&TM) team is seeking a Co-op Student to support key initiatives across Procurement, Contract Management, Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), operational reporting, process improvement, and AI-enabled innovation. jobs.title: Senior AML Advisory Specialist (18 month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work The AML Advisory team within the Compliance department is a Second Line of Defence function responsible for providing independent oversight, effective challenge and advice to first line business units as a subject matter expert on Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Terrorist Financing (AML/ATF), Sanctions Evasion (SE), and compliance-related matters. This position primarily assists the Senior Manager, AML Advisory, in the ongoing oversight, management and enhancement of Equitable Bank’s enterprise-wide AML/ATF and SE financial crimes program. The Senior Analyst, AML Advisory’s role is a multifaceted one. Responsibilities may include regulatory and policy guidance, risk assessment, change initiative reviews, AML/ATF/SE training and stakeholder engagement, ensuring AML/ATF/SE related policy and procedures are understood, maintained, and current. The role supports oversight and effective challenge to First Line businesses to support a comprehensive and effective Regulatory Compliance Management regime within the Bank and manage financial crimes, reputational and other operational risks. The environment is fast-paced and requires effective time management of multiple tasks and projects.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Commercial QA (12 month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Analyst reports to and supports the Senior Manager, Credit Risk, with respect to the management of all aspects of Commercial(Including the Special assets management unit & Specialized finance) credit risk across the Bank. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for reviewing loan portfolios with the objective of maintaining high-quality lending strategies and the monitoring of risk mitigation strategies. A key function of the role is to assist in providing assurance to the Senior Management on the soundness of underwriting processes and account management routines associated with the portfolio. Another key aspect of the role is to assist in the determination of where Equitable may be exposed to credit or other key risks and identify possible mitigating strategies and/or actions that can be implemented to minimize or eliminate the risk. Developing internal relationships with credit stakeholders is critical to the role.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Operational Risk Management
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Analyst, Operational Risk Management supports the Bank's Operational Risk Management framework by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and reporting non-financial risks. The role partners with business units across the organization to evaluate operational risks and controls, conduct independent control testing, oversee issue remediation activities, and support the Business Continuity Management program. The position helps ensure risks related to people, processes, systems, and external events are appropriately managed and reported while promoting a strong risk management culture across the Bank.

jobs.title: Senior Application Analyst (12 Months contract)

He/she acts as a technical lead and subject matter expert for a portfolio of complex applications, responsible for production support, administration, workflow development, testing, upgrades and documentation to meet business needs. Reporting to the Associate Director, Application Support, he/she works with business users, vendors and technical teams in a fast-paced environment, ensures incidents are triaged and resolved in a timely manner, meets regulatory and audit deadlines, and escalates risks.

The role establishes the Personal Banking approach to franchise value creation, including customer segmentation and lifetime value economics, joint value propositions and bundled offers, and channel strategy for customer growth. Working across Product, Marketing, Analytics, Loyalty, Digital and Operations, the Senior Director mobilizes cross-functional execution and is accountable for delivering the relationship deepening and franchise growth outcomes established through the annual plan.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, FP&A and Capital
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, FP&A and Capital leads enterprise FP&A forecasting, capital planning, and related financial analysis. The role integrates business and financial assumptions, earnings, balance sheet growth, Risk Weighted Assets (RWA), capital actions, and strategic priorities into a clear enterprise outlook and provides senior and executive management with decision-useful forecasts, scenario analysis, and recommendations. The Senior Manager partners closely with FP&A, Treasury, Risk, Accounting, and business leaders to coordinate forecast inputs, challenge assumptions, explain performance and outlook, and ensure capital implications are appropriately reflected across the Bank’s financial plans, while strengthening forecasting models, controls, processes, and team capability.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Java (Contract)
jobs.description_text: The work The Senior Software Engineer is an experienced, hands-on engineer within Digital Technology, responsible for designing, building, and supporting modern digital banking solutions. This role owns complex engineering work from design through production and contributes to technical decisions that help teams build secure, scalable, resilient, and maintainable software. The Senior Software Engineer works collaboratively across teams, shares knowledge, supports other engineers, and contributes to continuously improving engineering practices and software delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (18 Month Contract)
jobs.description_text: The Senior Technical Program Manager (STPM) reports to the Director, Technical Program Management. The STPM owns end-to-end plan management and delivery execution for highly complex technical programs across EQ Bank's Digital Banking ecosystem, with a strong emphasis on measurable business value, customer outcomes, reliability, and usability. The STPM leads execution across multiple interdependent teams and domains, proactively surfaces technical and non-technical risks, establishes mitigation plans, manages complex dependencies, drives decisions, and enables alignment across Engineering, Product, Business, Enterprise partners, and third parties. The STPM applies company policies and Enterprise Change Management requirements while balancing governance with modern product and technology delivery practices. The STPM operates effectively where scope, ownership, or the delivery path is ambiguous. The role is expected to build strong cross-functional relationships, influence senior stakeholders without authority, resolve escalated delivery constraints, and provide clear executive-level visibility of program health, trade-offs, and decisions.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Infrastructure Solutions (12 month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work The Staff Engineer plays a key role within the Infrastructure Solutions team, defining infrastructure strategies and roadmaps with a strong emphasis on network engineering initiatives. This role will involve finalizing designs and technical implementations that align with the architecture established by the Enterprise Architecture function, ensuring optimal use of technology within the organization. The specialist will contribute to the development of policies, processes, and procedures for Infrastructure & Operations (I&O) and provide expert advice on technology utilization to enhance overall enterprise value. In addition to these responsibilities, the position will focus on creating robust network architectures and developing high-level designs that meet business requirements. This includes designing network topologies, selecting appropriate technologies, and producing detailed documentation. The specialist will collaborate with various teams, including Azure Cloud Operations and business unit infrastructure requirements, to ensure alignment with organizational objectives while supporting high-level infrastructure needs across the enterprise.

jobs.title: Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management
jobs.description_text: Purpose of the Job The Vice President, Enterprise Risk Management is a senior member of the CRO’s leadership team and serves as the CRO and Deputy CRO’s primary partner on enterprise risk governance, leading the second-line ERM function and the continued development and operation of a forward-looking risk management program aligned with regulatory expectations and commensurate with EQ Bank’s size, scope and complexity. The VP, ERM will provide the vision and roadmap to further embed ERM across the organization, working closely with business leaders to strengthen risk management capabilities while providing independent oversight and effective challenge on strategic and business decisions. The role will oversee the Bank’s enterprise-wide view of risk, including its Board-approved Risk Appetite Framework, management and reporting of key risks, and reporting to the Board and Enterprise Risk Management Committee (ERMC), while supporting the CRO and Deputy CRO in interactions with OSFI and other regulatory stakeholders. The VP, ERM will also lead the risk management aspects of integration of PC Financial with EQ Bank and build a high-performing ERM team that is nimble and innovative, enabling EQ Bank to achieve its strategic objectives while operating within its risk appetite.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description_text: Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries. Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security. With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity. If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you! This role exists to give the Accounting team a dedicated leader, to shorten and de-risk the close, and to bring firm-grade technical rigour to judgement areas that currently escalate to the Controller.

As a Customer Success Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle - from solution evaluation and design through implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization. You will help customers deploy and scale Magnet solutions within complex environments by combining deep expertise in enterprise networking, security, cloud and hybrid architectures, integrations, investigative workflows, and troubleshooting with a strong understanding of customer goals and business outcomes. jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Hydrogen (CA)
jobs.description_text: LTA Research builds and flies next-generation airships. Our proof-of-concept aircraft, Pathfinder 1, is the largest aircraft flying today, and we operate it as a working test platform to push airship technology forward: moving cargo and people to places without roads, runways, or ports, including disaster relief when infrastructure is cut off. Weight matters in every decision we make. This senior role owns mechanical, thermal, and fluid systems from concept through flight test, with a central part in developing the hydrogen propulsion system for our next aircraft. The base salary range for this role is $135,000 - 160,000, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes a very competitive annual bonus, 401K Match, and other generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you.

jobs.title: Sr. QA Engineer – Outdoor Test Lead
jobs.description_text: People come to work at Parallel Wireless because we are building the future of telecom. They stay because they are challenged and driven by an incredible product and team. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, and our culture fosters an atmosphere of empowerment, trust, respect, and communication. Lead the outdoor (field) test activities for Parallel Wireless's wireless telecom and cloud-based 4G/5G ORAN solutions. The work location is in Israel and combines hands-on testing at outdoor sites in the field with lab work and close collaboration with R&D, product and test engineers across Parallel Wireless sites. As the senior engineer on the team, you'll own the outdoor test domain end-to-end — from defining the field test strategy and building the outdoor setups, through running drive and walk tests on live deployments, to analyzing RF/KPI results and driving issues to root cause with R&D. You will also mentor the team's junior test engineers and represent the outdoor test activity in front of customers during field trials and acceptance. *The position is based at our offices in Tzemach.

jobs.title: Sr. Tech Lead, Prod Dev (RAN, AI-Assisted RCA, Design & Development)
jobs.description_text: Parallel Wireless is transforming its Feature-Validation & Stability organization into a single Prod-Dev team — in the AI era there is no longer a separate "development" vs "validation" team. We are building a group of strong System Engineers who own a problem end to end: understand the complete product behavior, find the actual root cause, and contribute directly to the fix — accelerated by Claude / AI-assisted engineering. This is a pro-development, system-level problem-solving role. You will take a field or test issue and drive it the whole way: Issue → Reproduction → Cross-layer analysis → RCA → Code investigation → Fix → Validation You will not stop at "which component failed." You will name the root cause, prove it, and fix it.

jobs.title: Technical Lead, Production Dev (QA Automation (AI & Root Cause Analysis)

jobs.description_text: Qualifications & required skills- Understanding of end-to-end solutions for 4G/5G network architecture. Familiar with 3GPP RAN and O-RAN specifications and functionality. Development experience on Cellular Radio products complying with 3GPP specifications for E-UTRA (LTE) and NR. Familiar with communication interfaces: Ethernet / TCP/IP / UDP. Good knowledge of RAN protocols and interfaces: LTE/5G AS protocol layers — PHY, MAC, RLC, PDCP, RRC. Expert-level proficiency in the MAC and RLC layers is required Knowledge of AI/ML concepts and their application to RAN (e.g., network optimization, ML frameworks); hands-on experience applying AI/ML in a telecom/RAN context is a strong plus. Excellent log analysis and debugging skills. Must be strong in C/C++ programming and Linux OS. Hands-on experience debugging in a Linux environment with tools like GDB, QXDM, TM500, QCAT, etc. 8 - 10 years of work experience.

Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Pourquoi ce poste ? Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e comptable général senior capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

Our approach involves the creation of world-class player programs and efficiently scaling them across our player pool. Collaborating closely with other departments, we establish effective frameworks for exploration, learning, and development. This role also includes the opportunity to impact player development through player education, participating in player meetings, player feedback and other responsibilities that support the staff and players at the academy. jobs.title: Index Analyst Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: About Syntax Data Syntax LLC is a financial data and technology company that codifies business models into a relational system we call Affinity Data™. Syntax operates through three segments: Affinity Data™, Syntax Direct™, and Syntax Indices™. Using its patented FIS® technology inspired by systems sciences, the Affinity Data™ segment offers comprehensive, granular product-line revenue data. Syntax Direct™ uses this data to facilitate the creation and ongoing management of direct indexing solutions and rules-based equity portfolios through an automated platform. Syntax Indices™ offers customized and proprietary indices, including core global benchmarks, thematic, smart beta, defined outcome, and target volatility indices. These indices serve as the foundation for a range of financial products, including ETFs, UITs, and structured products. About the Role The Index Intern will support our team by assisting with the research, creation, and development of market indices.

jobs.title: Clinical Quality and Compliance Coordinator Maryland UM
jobs.description_text: As the Clinical Quality and Compliance Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating quality assurance (QA), quality improvement (QI), accreditation, regulatory compliance, and credentialing activities across clinical programs, including Utilization Management (UM), Case Management (CM), and Disease Management (DM). You will provide hands-on support for audit activities, quality improvement initiatives, accreditation readiness, state regulatory filings, credentialing processes, and staff education. You will assist with the development and execution of audit tools and education materials under direction and supports tracking, documentation, and monitoring activities to ensure compliance with URAC, NCQA, state regulatory, and contractual requirements. Telligen will consider candidates living in Iowa or Maryland. Telligen will consider internal candidates in other states.

jobs.title: Nurse Care Manager (RN)
jobs.description_text: As a Nurse Care Manager (RN), you will be responsible for care management of patients with acute and chronic medical conditions and the assessment of care needs of vulnerable populations for various clients. This is a Hybrid position at either our West Des Moines, IA office or our Oklahoma City, OK office. This position is contingent on obtaining a new, pending contract.

jobs.title: Quality Improvement Advisor
jobs.description_text: As a Quality Improvement Advisor, you will serve as the primary liaison and coach for hospitals, focusing on identifying areas for improving patient care, safety, and outcomes, implementing improvement activities and achieving healthcare goals. While this is a remote position, Telligen is focused on applicants who live in Missouri. Telligen will also consider applicants who live in Iowa, Kansas, or Nebraska.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Commercial, Spotify Technology
jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments. As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow. You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.

jobs.title: Analyst, Royalty Operations
jobs.description_text: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

jobs.title: Artist & Label Partnerships Manager - GSA (15-month fixed-term)
jobs.description_text: We have a great opportunity for an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager to come and join the band in Berlin. The Artist & Label Partnerships team is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors. As an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager your mission is to ensure that key artists, managers, and labels see Spotify as the #1 partner for artist development and monetization. In this role you will work with a set of core label partners and artists. This role has a strong focus on launching innovative partnerships and initiatives and you will drive activations that enable, educate, and unlock new opportunities for our partners and Spotify. We seek a highly motivated partner manager based in Berlin with a strong partnerships, music marketing and music / entertainment / media background. This individual must be able to prioritize, multi-task, and influence in a fast paced environment. This role is on a 15-month fixed-term contract.

jobs.title: Associate Artist Label Partnerships Manager, South Korea
jobs.description_text: Spotify’s Artist & Label Partnerships (ALP) team works with artists, managers, record labels and distributors to help artists grow their audiences and connect with fans. As an Associate Artist & Label Partnerships Manager on the Korea Music team, you’ll manage relationships with selected partners and lead campaigns that help Korean artists reach more listeners at home and around the world. You’ll work with artist and label teams to understand their goals and turn them into opportunities for fans to discover and engage with their music.

jobs.title: Audiobook Licensing & Partnerships Manager - Japan
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, we are redefining the audiobook industry with our innovative Audiobooks in Premium model. Our mission is to empower creators and consumers by delivering the best audiobook content with unmatched quality and accessibility. We are building a thriving ecosystem that scales with creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology. We’re building Spotify’s audiobook business in Japan and looking for someone to lead our relationships with Japanese publishers. You’ll help build our publisher portfolio and secure a catalogue that resonates with listeners in Japan. After launch, you’ll keep owning and growing these partnerships so they deliver lasting value for Spotify and our publishing partners.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our Subscriptions mission helps make the subscription experience seamless and reliable for millions of listeners around the world. We're building the technology that supports subscribers throughout their journey, from their first purchase to renewals, plan changes, and beyond. We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join Rover, the team responsible for Spotify's core subscription system. Our services manage the lifecycle of every Spotify subscription, including activation, renewals, plan changes, grace periods, and cancellations. You'll help build and improve the backend services and data systems that millions of subscribers depend on. Whether you're growing your engineering experience or looking for a new technical challenge, you'll have opportunities to learn, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact on Spotify's subscription experience.

jobs.title: Client Partner - Emerging & Scaled (French Speaking)
jobs.description_text: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

jobs.title: Client Partner ANZ
jobs.description_text: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. Spotify is seeking a talented and dynamic individual to join the team as a Contractor - Client Partner based in Sydney. This role will be responsible for driving revenue growth and building long-term relationships with key advertising clients and agencies. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales, marketing, and product teams to deliver innovative advertising solutions that meet the needs of our clients while maximising revenue opportunities for Spotify. Please note this is a fixed-term, 12 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

jobs.title: Data Scientist  - Business Analytics
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries. In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features focused on payments and payments fraud. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership. At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

jobs.title: Demand Generation & Campaign Operations Manager
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. You run our websites, search, webinars and email across the Spotify Technology portfolio. Your job is to bring people into the funnel and move them through it: from finding us in search or at a webinar, to signing up, to becoming an active user, to a meeting with sales. You also own the numbers. Every week you tell the team what’s working, what isn’t and what we’re changing. You work AI-first, you know our martech stack inside out, and you use the newest features of both.

jobs.title: Editor, UK & Ireland
jobs.description_text: The Music Mission team owns Spotify’s end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale. Editorial UK & Ireland sits at the heart of the listener experience on Spotify. We reflect culture and drive artist discovery through playlists, storytelling formats, and tools, with a focus on new music. As our Pop Editor, you’ll bring deep cultural expertise and a data-informed approach to shape how millions of people discover music across playlists, video, and other parts of the app.

jobs.title: Growth Lead - Japan
jobs.description_text: Join Spotify's Japan Growth team and help more listeners discover the value of Spotify Premium. As part of our Markets & Subscriptions organisation, you'll play a key role in growing our subscriber base in one of Spotify's most important markets. Japan is Spotify's only single-country region, and we're entering an exciting new chapter focused on partnerships and sustainable growth. Working across marketing, product, data and commercial teams, you'll shape our growth strategy, turn customer insights into action and find new ways to connect Japanese listeners with Spotify Premium. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your leadership responsibilities over time.

jobs.title: Head of Markets Strategy & Operations, Japan
jobs.description_text: The Markets team is responsible for managing Spotify’s regions and their performance across all business-relevant metrics. Our team consists of regional Managing Directors and Market Strategy & Operation Managers (MSO). We are looking for a strategic, analytically-driven and open-minded character to support our efforts in Japan. As Head of Market Strategy and Operations, you will be responsible for strategic direction based on business analysis and insights; business planning; regional operating processes; and managing cross-functional projects by building strong relationships across the company. In this position, you will work closely with global stakeholder, local functional leadership and report to the Managing Director, Japan

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business. Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions. Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
jobs.description_text: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. At Spotify, great personalization is about more than recommending the right song. It's about creating listening experiences that feel effortless and meaningful while balancing the needs of listeners, creators, and our business. The Samba team, part of Spotify's Personalization Mission, works on multi-objective balancing and sequencing for personalized listening experiences like Autoplay, Radio, and Mixes. Our engineers bring together machine learning, backend engineering, and data engineering to build systems that support Spotify's financial objectives while keeping listeners at the center of what we do. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead this team, develop our engineers, and help shape the technical direction of systems that influence how millions of people experience Spotify.

jobs.title: Manager, International Audiobook Licensing & Partnerships
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, we’re building a thriving audiobook ecosystem that connects authors and publishers with listeners around the world. As our audiobook business expands into new markets, we’re looking for someone to grow our international publisher portfolio. You’ll build relationships with publishers of all sizes, help them bring their catalogues to Spotify, and shape scalable ways to onboard and support them. Your goal is to make Spotify a trusted home for publishers audiobooks, combining a welcoming partner experience with sustainable commercial growth.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - TV & Desktop
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer. As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

jobs.title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success. Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager - Spotify Technology
jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments. As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.

jobs.title: Security Engineer - Product Security
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Security engineers at Spotify help protect our environment and more than 700 million users. Within Platform, our Product Security team evaluates and communicates Spotify's security posture, helping developers and leadership make informed decisions about security risks. We own the vulnerability management platform, supporting the full lifecycle of identifying, attributing, remediating, and reporting security vulnerabilities. As AI changes how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited, we're evolving how Spotify responds. We're looking for a Security Engineer to help transform vulnerability findings into reliable, actionable code improvements using agentic AI. You'll build the tools, workflows, and evaluation frameworks that make automated remediation more effective, scalable, and safe, while helping developers focus on building great experiences for our users.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it. As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We own music content ingestion at Spotify, which is how music from labels, distributors and other partners gets onto the platform. We receive industry-standard deliveries, validate them, and turn them into the catalog data that teams across Spotify build on, including lyrics, rights and supply data. As we add new content types and partners, we’re building an ingestion platform that scales without a custom build every time.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
jobs.description_text: The Subscriptions Mission builds and scales the products, platforms, and business models that turn free listeners into lifelong Premium subscribers. We focus on attracting new subscribers, improving conversion and retention, and creating seamless commerce experiences that support Spotify's growth and bring fans closer to the creators they love. At Spotify, subscription data helps shape the decisions and experiences behind our 700M+ monthly active users and 290M+ Premium subscribers. You'll join a collaborative team building the backend systems that power merchandising, personalized experiences, and subscription journeys at a global scale. Your work will help listeners discover the value of Premium and give them more reasons to stay.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Free and Premium Conversion
jobs.description_text: Hundreds of millions of people come to Spotify to listen for free. Our ambition is to make that experience great while helping listeners discover the value of Premium. Getting that balance right is one of the most important opportunities for Spotify's continued growth. The Freemium Funnel team shapes the journey from Free listening to Premium subscription and beyond. We bring together Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Research, and Marketing to understand what listeners value, remove barriers to conversion, and create experiences that make Premium a compelling choice. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Free and Conversion Surfaces team. You'll shape how listeners engage with Spotify Free, discover Premium, make the decision to subscribe, and experience their first moments as paying subscribers. From Premium education to conversion experiences and early retention, you'll work on meaningful product challenges that directly influence Spotify's growth. This is an opportunity to think strategically, build at scale, and turn complex challenges into simple, engaging experiences that work for both our listeners and our business.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Spotify Connect
jobs.description_text: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to make Spotify easier to enjoy across the devices people use every day. You will work in Seamless within Platform & Partner Experience, focusing on Spotify Connect and the experiences that help people find, choose, and control where Spotify plays. You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager — Subscriptions (Freemium)
jobs.description_text: Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on helping listeners discover, experience, and unlock the full value of Spotify through awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help shape the future of Spotify's Freemium experience. You'll lead product initiatives that make Premium more compelling, improve the journey from Free to Paid, and create experiences that reflect the needs of local audiences. Working closely with engineering, design, data science, research, marketing, and regional teams, you'll turn consumer insights into meaningful product experiences that drive sustainable subscriber growth.

jobs.title: Social Marketing Manager, Australia & New Zealand
jobs.description_text: Spotify is looking for a Social Marketing Manager with deep understanding, endless curiosity, and proven ability to shape culture through social media activity. This person will run the always-on social presence for Spotify in Australia and New Zealand across TikTok and Meta accounts. You’ll bring a strong understanding of youth culture, brand tone and what commands attention, an enthusiasm to keep trying new things, and the ability to make informed decisions at pace. You’ll shape what Spotify looks, sounds and feels like in the feed, across everything from Premium, product, music and culture moments to creating content with the artists, podcasters and authors our listeners love and have yet to discover. You’ll manage key external relationships with our social, influencer and video production agencies, and work closely with artists, talent and teams across Spotify locally and globally – turning strategy into content people watch, remember and want to share.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design

We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product. As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Des

jobs.title: Studio & Project Manager

The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale. The Artist & Label Partnerships team (ALP) is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels and distributors across Sweden. You'll lead the studio and its projects with support from the wider ALP team, and project manage selected ALP initiatives so key partners see Spotify as their number one partner.

jobs.title: Tax Manager - Transfer Pricing [Analytics, Models & AI]
jobs.description_text: We’re looking for a Tax Manager to join Spotify’s Global Transfer Pricing team, reporting to the Director of Global Transfer Pricing. In this role you’ll focus on analytics, modelling and AI. You’ll drive the development of Spotify’s global transfer pricing models and economic analyses, keeping our intercompany pricing accurate, efficient and defensible in every jurisdiction where we operate. You’ll also help lead the team’s use of AI tools and automation to change how transfer pricing work gets done, from forecasting and projections to audit support. You’ll join a team of skilled, dedicated colleagues in a fast-moving international company, with plenty of room to take on responsibility. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Within the System Engineering team, lead the technical coordination needed to adapt Lightspeed’s low Earth orbit constellation and associated ground infrastructure for military Ka-band communications supporting the Enhanced Satellite Communications Project - Polar (ESCP-P) and other defence customers. This is a senior individual-contributor role in which you will lead technical work across all Lightspeed teams without managing staff. You will build on established designs, analyses, and test plans, focusing additional analysis where decisions require it. ESCP-P is intended to meet Government of Canada requirements by providing the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) with secure, resilient, high-speed communications for operations at home and abroad, particularly in Arctic and other high-latitude regions. The project supports Canada’s Arctic sovereignty and continental defence, including interoperability with the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) and North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD).

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Specialist

Working with Sales Operations, subject matter experts, and cross-functional partners, the Specialist creates clear, engaging, and scalable learning experiences that support employee success. These solutions help employees confidently adopt and apply Sales Operations systems, capabilities, and business processes, improving adoption, knowledge retention, and performance. The ideal candidate brings 3-5 years of relevant experience, strong instructional design and content-development capabilities, and the ability to independently own work from concept through delivery. AI, automation, and emerging technologies are expected to be integral to how the role develops content, improves workflows, and increases operational efficiency.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Mexico & Central America
jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com

jobs.title: Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Are you passionate about breakthrough technologies and eager to shape the future of satellite-based solutions for defence and national security? We are seeking a Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist to help shape new satellite-enabled capabilities for Canadian and allied defence users. Reporting to the Director, Research & Development, Defence Satellite Mission Solutions, you will lead multidisciplinary investigations from mission-need qualification through initial prototype laboratory validation. Initial opportunities include system features such as alternative positioning, navigation and timing (PNT), optical relay connectivity with other satellite systems, and space-domain awareness data products. You will combine technical depth with systems thinking, practical experimentation and multidisciplinary leadership.

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Developer
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking a Senior DevSecOps Developer to help build and operate secure embedded and cloud-native software delivery environments. This role will provide technical leadership for the implementation and integration of security capabilities within CI/CD pipelines, including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), software supply-chain security, vulnerability management, artifact integrity, and code signing. Working within the Engineering DevSecOps team and closely with the CI/CD Architecture Lead, the Senior DevSecOps Security Engineer will partner with development teams to embed security controls into engineering workflows, strengthen secure development practices, and support the remediation of vulnerabilities identified through automated tooling. The role will also collaborate closely with Telesat Cybersecurity and Compliance teams to translate security policies, standards, and control requirements into practical, automated engineering controls.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager

Combining strong program leadership with telecommunications/SATCOM knowledge, the Senior Program Manager works across engineering, System Architecture, Product Owners, Integration and Test, program controls, Procurement, Operations, and external suppliers to manage dependencies, risks, commitments, and critical decisions. The role may establish a new program or take ownership of an in-flight delivery, quickly building a fact-based view of status, priorities, critical path, supplier commitments, and recovery needs. Success requires strong supplier and stakeholder leadership, commercial and contractual awareness, and a delivery-focused approach that drives issues and decisions to closure.

jobs.title: Senior Python Test Automation Engineer

You will work closely with software developers, DevOps engineers, and architects to improve software quality, accelerate release cycles, and ensure reliable validation of APIs, user interfaces, and microservices. In addition to hands-on development, you will mentor engineers, coordinate testing activities, and help drive automation best practices across the team.

jobs.title: Senior Spectrum Engineer
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The incumbent is responsible for securing, maintaining, and protecting the spectrum and orbital rights required to support Telesat's GSO and NGSO satellite systems. The role leads complex spectrum engineering, ITU filing and coordination activities; conducts interference and compatibility analyses; supports satellite system design from a spectrum and regulatory perspective; and represents Telesat in technical coordination discussions with satellite operators, administrations, and relevant domestic and international regulatory bodies. The position provides technical and regulatory advice that informs satellite system design, spectrum strategy, and regulatory decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Writer

jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Senior Technical Writer is responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving Engineering Design Documentation across the Lightspeed program. This role serves as the central documentation authority for component-level architecture and design knowledge, ensuring that engineering teams have access to accurate, consistent, and maintainable technical documentation. The role supports the development of both High Level Design (HLD) and Detailed Design Description (DDD) documentation for key Engineering Segment components such as On-Board Processor Software Systems, User Terminals (UTs) Systems, LS LS-BB and ACU Systems The successful candidate works closely with System Architects, Software Architects, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), Developers, Integration Teams, and Product Owners to transform existing engineering knowledge into structured, maintainable design documentation. The documentation produced complements existing Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), Interface Control Documents (ICDs), Technical Requirement Documents (TRDs), Architecture Reviews, Confluence content, Implementation repositories Capella (MBSE) content and acts as the authoritative engineering knowledge repository for internal engineering teams.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist - Germany Forward Deployed
jobs.description_text: NOTE: Although this position is in support of our US Government work, this role is located in Wiesbaden, Germany. What We're About At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around leveraging data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality. If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you. What We Do As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be. Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale.
